notes.title: Perks Update! v0.85
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, Tinfoil here![/p][p][/p][p]Its been a bit more than a week since the early access release and I'm happy to have gotten alot of feedback over these days. This update will be adding the Perk System to the game in preparation for all the future progression system the game will have. The next couple of updates will focus on fixing more issues that might come from this. But other than that, listening to the players and making updates as they feel the game needs![/p][p][/p][p]- Perks![/p][p]	- Characters have their own minor perk[/p][p]	- Major perks can be unlocked in the perk tab in the character page. 2 can be equipped at a time[/p][p]- New Achievements:[/p][p]	- Getting Started[/p][p]	- Refused Service[/p][p]	- Wet Boy[/p][p]	- Careful![/p][p]- Two New Cosmetics[/p][p]	- Big Sword[/p][p]	- The Guzzler[/p][p]- Fixed Yummy! Achievement not being able to trigger[/p][p]- Expert Achievement Scoring adjustments[/p][p]- Fixed Steam Achievement not always triggering alongside the in-game achievements[/p][p]- Cut chicken and diced fish locked until 3-3. When they are needed[/p][p]- Removed Super hearing endless perk (Now a player perk)[/p][p]- Jealous Customers Nerf. 5 second debuff -> 10 seconds[/p][p]- New Endless perk: Hammer (Move any gameplay station)[/p][p]- Popular Business nerf: Increased value 2 -> 1 [/p][p]- Increased Endless difficulty base across all maps[/p][p]- Grandmaster Cook is needed for galaxy chef hat now instead of Star Chef[/p][p]- Endless perks properly work for choice limits[/p][p]- Fixed bug where placing a food piece into a pot while on a crane would cause infinite food[/p][p]- Fixed bug where starting another day with a pot on the stove would take the pot off of the stove[/p][p]- Throwing a dirty dish near the sink will trigger it's auto-catch, instead of needing to start further away[/p][p]- Fixed polaroid not working for clients[/p][p]- Fixed jumping from aircannon, geyser stopping your momentum[/p][p]- Max frame rate is now capped to your monitor, instead of a hard cap of 240[/p]

notes.title: QoL Updates v0.81b
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Here's a patch notes for the current fixes. Thank you for the players who gave feedback and reports!

- Side Orders will now detect better when thrown at a table
- Polaroid Item added to game
- Reduced stars needed for special levels (5 stars less)
- Improved Portal teleport consistency, now client-based teleporting.
- Endless Perks now sometimes incorporate requirements to show up
- [Shady Dealings] endless perk
- Fixed baked fish not allowing rice to be placed in it
- Some endless perks will come with multi choices. I.E. ingredient box will now give you three options
- You can now vote for rerolls and skips as non-host in endless
- Noodles in a pot now show up as burnt when they burn
- You can take out charcoal from a burnt pot instead of having to dump it in trash
- You can now throw valid foods into a pot when it is on a stove to add to it
- Portable camera on all maps + you can interact with it before the store opens
- Burnt pots no longer give you an non-burnt food when pulling it out
- Fixed how some levels don't match up with the expert thresholds
- Fixed Star Chef Achievement
